items.title: Who and what take different shapes
items.caption: The who-word follows *ʻo* directly. The noun-like what-word carries the article *le* between them.

cells.en: the question word for who: stands after *ʻo* at the front of a who-question
the question word for what: stands after *ʻo le* at the front of a what-question

items.title: The same words become a question
